-753.text: Traditional founding of the city of Rome by Romulus

-509.text: The Roman Republic was established after the overthrow of the monarchy

-264.text: The First Punic War began between Rome and Carthage

-44.text: Julius Caesar was assassinated in the Senate

-27.text: Augustus became Rome's first emperor, founding the Roman Empire

80.text: The Colosseum was completed in Rome

117.text: The Roman Empire reached its greatest territorial extent under Trajan

313.text: Emperor Constantine issued the Edict of Milan, legalizing Christianity

395.text: The Roman Empire split permanently into Western and Eastern halves

476.text: The Western Roman Empire fell when Romulus Augustulus was deposed by Odoacer
